newsitem.title: USA: Cyrix stock rises in after-hours trading.
newsitem.headline: Cyrix stock rises in after-hours trading.

text.p: Cyrix Corp's stock rose to 21 in after-hours trading from its Nasdaq close at 17-3/4 as investors reacted to the release of the company's quarterly earnings late Wednesday afternoon, dealers said.
The rise was "substantially due to its earnings," one trader said.
The company, which makes chips for the desktop personal computers, said first-quarter profit rose to $0.33 from $0.10 in the same period the previous year.
Cyrix attributed the rise to strong customer acceptance of its microprocessors, higher gross margins and improved manufacturing efficiencies.
